notes.note: Quest009.bla mapping in this table is TextIdOffset+N -> row N (not N+1): verified by +86 (Ankh) landing on row 86 with 87/88 empty, +89..+91 narration, +92 ??? cry, +100 Pigmon, +139 Ankh, +156 quest-complete. Leader block 31-45 = TextIdOffset+31+pt in Pt_Chara_Check order Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, God, Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O Sword, W (Shotaro), OOO (default). Rows 31-34 are in quest_008. 'Are' (that one) = the Antlar nest.
00 (Setsuna). Source writes hosoku with the 'supplement' kanji, a common typo for 'capture/acquire'; read as 'Target acquired.'
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36, +46). 'Capture Ray' matches story_025/026 for Antlar's beam.

Leader block 48-62 = +48+pt, same order: 48-50 Ultraman/Seven/Taro, 51 Mebius, 52 Zero, 53-54 Wing Zero/00 (curt), 55-57 Nu/Zeta/God, 58 Rider 1, 59 Black RX, 60 Momotaros, 61 Shotaro, 62 OOO. 'Friend' = the ally Maganac said was dragged into the nest (Pigmon, not yet identified). The watashi-tachi and ore-tachi forms with the same -te morao ending share one English line.
Momotaros. 'Don't play dumb' has no prompt in the played sequence (Antlar's denial 63 is unreferenced); kept as written.

Rows 63-84 are NOT referenced by Quest009.bla (the event goes from +48+pt straight to GoToBattle; constants 63-84 absent). Speakers inferred: 63/64/66/69 Antlar (it speaks here; refers to the captive as 'that thing', so 'it'), 65 likely Ankh egging the party on, 67-68 unknown party voices (rough) reacting to more Antlars appearing.

Unreferenced leader block 70-84 in the same 15-slot order (wording matches: 74 Zero cocky, 75 Heero 'commencing elimination', 76 Setsuna names 00, 78 Kamille, 80 Rider 1 '-ga ii', 82 Momotaros 'ore-sama' = 'the great me', 83 Shotaro, 84 OOO). 79 (God) has identical Japanese to 70-72, so identical English. Second source line break in 75 was a trailing newline; dropped.
Ankh (+86), right after the battle; the nest search narration 89-91 follows.

Narration (CharaNameOut). '{8074} and the others' as in earlier quest/story narration. 'the Antlar nest' lowercase: this is the new nest from the quest description, not the named story spot 'Antlar's Nest'.
Pigmon's sound under the '???' name box (CHARA_NAME 30), before the party recognises it.

Branch 1 (Ultra leader): +93+pt and +101+pt only make sense for pt 0-4, so 93-97 = Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero and 101-105 likewise (105 Zero 'nan da ze'). Rows 98-99 unreferenced (speakers unknown: 98 rough non-Ultra, 99 an Ultra who knows Pigmon); 106-113 are empty.
Pigmon (CHARA_NAME 267, +100). Pigmon's sentence-final 'ppi' tic rendered as a '-pi' suffix (cf. Jashrine's '-jaja'); no earlier English precedent, keep consistent in quest_010.
Mebius (polite). Pigmon is glossary g=n, so 'it' for a kaiju.
Branch 2 (no Ultra leader): Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36, +114), then +116 Pigmon's thanks under the '???' box, then +139 Ankh. Row 115 unreferenced (duplicate of 99).

Rows 118-127 (127 in quest_010) are an unreferenced 10-row block, one per non-Ultra leader. 'Koitsu' rendered without gender ('this'); 'the friend we came for' makes clear it is the ally the party set out to rescue.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers from Quest009.bla; in this table TextIdOffset+N plays row N (checked against empty rows 87-88/106-113). Played: leader blocks 31-45 and 48-62 (15-slot order Ultraman..OOO), Ankh 46/86/114, Antlar 47, ??? 92, Pigmon 100/116, Ultra-only leader rows 93-97/101-105. Unreferenced (speakers inferred): 63-84 (Antlar taunts and a 15-slot leader block), 98-99, 115, 118-126. New style choice: Pigmon's 'ppi' tic as '-pi' suffix. No new names.
